<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

The FP8 variant still passes `--enable-mamba-fine-grained-prefix-cache`, renamed to `--enable-mamba-shared-prefix-checkpoint` in v0.31.0 (#57382). With the recipe's 0.31.0 floor, the FP8 command never parses.

## Test Plan

```
node scripts/validate-source.mjs --source vllm --dir recipes   (vllm-project/recipes) → valid
FP8 renderings in the generated JSON                          → old flag 0, new flag 8
grep -- --enable-mamba-shared-prefix-checkpoint vllm/engine/arg_utils.py  @v0.31.0, v0.32.0 → present
```

---
